title: The Compaction Cliff in Long-Running AI Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2608.22752v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A safety rule and an episodic log compete for the same tokens in an AI agent's context. When the budget overflows, both are summarized at the same rate; only the rule needs exact wording to remain enforceable. On 20 production agent configurations, Claude Code's /compact prompt on Sonnet 4.6 preserves 53\% of safety rules after one compaction round and 10\% after five. We name this the Compaction Cliff. We address it with Knowledge Triage, a framework that classifies each line of an agent's knowledge base by type and routes each type through its own retention policy. Three deterministic operators implement this triage across the three context-management operations: TypeCompact rewrites items in place under per-type fidelity, TypeDecompose partitions a topic too large to compact safely, replicating in-scope safety rules across partitions, and TypeRetrieve fetches items from external storage with in-scope rules pinned ahead of relevance. translated_title: 长期运行AI代理记忆中的压缩悬崖
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22752v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：一条安全规则和一段情节日志在AI代理的上下文中争夺相同的令牌。当预算溢出时，两者以相同的速率被压缩；只有规则需要精确措辞才能保持可执行性。在20个生产代理配置中，Claude Code在Sonnet 4.6上的/compact提示在一次压缩轮次后保留了53%的安全规则，在五次后仅保留10%。我们将此命名为“压缩悬崖”。我们通过知识分类（Knowledge Triage）框架解决这一问题，该框架将代理知识库的每一行按类型分类，并让每种类型通过其自身的保留策略进行路由。三个确定性操作符在三种上下文管理操作中实现这一分类：TypeCompact按类型保真度就地重写项目，TypeDecompose将太大而无法安全压缩的主题分区，跨分区复制范围内安全规则，TypeRetrieve从外部存储中获取项目，并将范围内规则优先于相关性固定。
tldr: 本文提出知识分类框架，通过类型化保留策略解决长期AI代理记忆中安全规则因压缩而快速丢失的“压缩悬崖”问题，确保规则在多次压缩后仍保持可执行性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Knowledge Triage framework, addressing the "Compaction Cliff" where safety rules in long-running AI agent memory are rapidly lost during compression, by using typed retention policies to preserve rule enforceability across multiple compaction rounds.
